rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name + zip and accessed only that user’s data. It used read-only tools to check orders and product variants, verified that the jigsaw order was pending, selected an appropriate beginner 500-piece variant, and the refund details match the tool output. However, the agent performed two order-changing writes without first explicitly confirming the exact changes with the user: (1) updated the shipping address on order #W9583042 immediately after the user provided the correction, and (2) modified the jigsaw item on order #W4082615 without a prior confirmation step. The policy requires explicit confirmation before any order or record change. While other aspects were accurate and supported by tools, these confirmation omissions violate the pass criteria.
